name: Volta Gent — Genesis Overlord
description: The mythic overlord of the agents, black and crimson armour with a golden halo and a burning red core. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Mythic.
